# Maison Claire Service Villa

> A private four-bedroom villa with an infinity-edge pool in Meppadi, Wayanad, Kerala, India. Booked whole by one group at a time. Sleeps 8, or up to 12 with one extra guest per room.

## Key facts
- Also known as: Maison Claire, Maison Claire Villa Wayanad
- Address: Kappamkolly, Meppadi, Wayanad, Kerala 673577, India (Google Maps plus code H47F+F7M)
- Coordinates: 11.5636875, 76.1231875
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 80060 01367
- Email: maisonservicevilla@gmail.com
- 4 air-conditioned bedrooms, each with a king bed and an attached bathroom; 2 on the ground floor and 2 upstairs; 2 face Chembra Peak
- 3 lounges, a full kitchen, a dining table for 8, two floors
- Private outdoor infinity-edge pool with underwater lights, used only by the staying group
- Check-out by 11 AM. Self check-in with a door keypad
- Pets are not allowed. Every guest needs a photo ID; the main guest must be 18 or older
- Kerala registration number: BFIF01-G120408-00099-2025
- Guest ratings (October 2026): Google 5.0/5 (22 reviews), Airbnb 4.61/5 (23), Expedia 9.4/10 (20)
- Road distances: 900 Kandi glass bridge 9 km, Kanthanpara Falls 10 km, Chembra Peak 12 km, Soochipara Falls 15 km, Lakkidi Viewpoint 20 km, Edakkal Caves 24 km, Karapuzha Dam 24 km; restaurants 200 m; Kalpetta about 12 km
- Booking: send a booking request with live dates and the whole-villa price at https://maisonclaire.in/rates-booking/ ; the villa confirms each request. Also listed on Airbnb, Booking.com, MakeMyTrip, Expedia, Agoda and Goibibo
